description.default: An image-generation-first local gateway for SenseNova (SenseTime): text-to-image and image editing on the U series. Every image is generated straight to disk and previewed in the chat first — you decide whether to upload or keep it. Multi-key pool with automatic rotation.
description.zh-CN: 专为 AI 生图做的商汤（SenseNova）本地网关：文生图、参考图改图，U 系列模型开箱即用。图片生成后立刻落盘并在聊天里先给你预览，你确认满意再决定上不上传、要不要保存，不满意就重生成；多 API Key 池自动轮换，掉一个不影响出图。

description.default: Local OpenAI-compatible image generation endpoint on 127.0.0.1:18918, backed by SenseNova.
description.zh-CN: 本机 127.0.0.1:18918 的生图入口，后端是商汤（SenseNova），对话与文生图共用同一个 OpenAI 兼容地址。

description.default: Show the SenseNova image gateway run state, base URL, API key state, default image models and recent logs.
description.zh-CN: 查看商汤生图网关的运行状态、地址、Key 状态、默认生图模型与最近日志。

description.default: Restart the local SenseNova image gateway process.
description.zh-CN: 重启本地商汤生图网关进程。

description.default: Generate an image with SenseNova U series (text-to-image) and save it as a PNG. After this tool returns, immediately call sendFile with the returned path so the image is previewed in the chat, then let the user decide whether to upload it; never reply with a link or a bare path.
description.zh-CN: 用商汤 U 系列模型文生图并保存为 PNG。重要：本工具返回后必须立即调用 sendFile，把返回的 path 作为图片发给用户预览，让用户看过之后再决定上不上传；不要只回复链接或路径。
